name: Pension Benefit Guaranty Corp. v. LTV Corp.
summary: The Supreme Court upheld the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation's authority to restore terminated pension plans and addressed the broad federal interest in ensuring the stability and proper administration of pension benefit systems.
significance: This case addresses the scope of ERISA's regulatory framework and federal authority over pension benefits, providing background on how Congress intended federal law to comprehensively govern retirement plan administration.
